=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:989-994 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The last run removed the `max(deadline, time.monotonic() + BASELINE_MIN_SECS)` floor, so `_baseline_target_statuses` now reruns red-on-base acceptance targets with the plain gate `deadline` (called from `run_gate` line 1050). That rerun happens after the head run and after `classify_baseline` (floored at line 1037). When the budget is used up, `_run_one` (lines 650-653) returns "timeout" without starting the test.
  WHY: Every red-on-base target that passed on head is recorded as `base: "unverified"`, which `_test_status` scores as "not run". The done-check therefore cannot reach `met`, real "unmet (passes on base)" results are lost, and `ai:acceptance-unmet` is never removed. The new comment saying "classify_baseline already takes the one BASELINE_MIN_SECS floor" is false, because the floor exists only at the call site on line 1037. No test covers the budget-exhausted path. All reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high). Suggested fix: compute one `baseline_deadline` and pass it to both calls.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:987-996 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_baseline_target_statuses` calls `plan_units(repo, base_selection)` on the head tree, then runs those units with `baseline` as the working directory.
  WHY: `plan_units` (lines 578-582, 593-606) reads the head tree's workflow, pytest and package configuration. If that configuration differs from base, the planned units can name commands or paths that do not match the baseline tree. The result is wrong unverified/fail red-on-base statuses and an inflated `unmet_count`. All three flagging reviewers rated it MAJOR (mapped to high). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this concern in its verification notes: `classify_baseline` (line 813-815) already reruns units planned on head against the baseline cwd.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:880-894 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The unmet branch of `review_prepush_test_gate_acceptance_label_main` calls `ensure_label_exists "ai:acceptance-unmet"` unconditionally before the POST to `issues/{n}/labels`. Because the per-process `_AI_LABEL_ENSURED_CACHE` always misses, `ensure_label_exists` issues a `gh label create` write every time (scripts/label_helpers.sh:194).
  WHY: Every newly-unmet round makes 2 GitHub writes, which breaks the documented "at most 1 label write per review round" (plan item 8, script header, function comment, agents.d "API budget" bullet). `test_acceptance_label_writes_at_most_once` passes only because `_with_fake_gh` never stages `label_helpers.sh`. All reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low). Suggested fix: POST first, and call `ensure_label_exists` and retry only if the POST fails.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:860-865 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The label sync uses `ensure_label_exists`, but nothing guarantees the function is defined (`label_helpers.sh` is sourced only if it exists).
  WHY: This could cause a silent failure or a shell crash, which would break the fail-open contract. Rated NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this in its verification notes because the call is guarded by `type ensure_label_exists`.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:860-865 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Label removal is skipped when the PR's labels are unknown, i.e. when PR_PAYLOAD_FILE does not carry them.
  WHY: An existing `ai:acceptance-unmet` label can stay forever after the done-check is met, because the cleanup logic skips the DELETE. Rated NIT.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:865-874 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The labels-read loop breaks on the first file with a non-empty `labels` string. A `PR_PAYLOAD_FILE` with `"labels": []` yields `[]`, which counts as non-empty, so it sets `has=no` before `PR_META_FILE` is consulted.
  WHY: If `PR_META_FILE` carries `ai:acceptance-unmet` but the payload's labels array is empty, both the DELETE and POST branches are skipped and the label drifts from the gate's verdict. The precedence is undocumented and untested. Rated NIT.
- scripts/acceptance_check.py:545-547 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `gate_result` iterates `obj["checks"]` only when `state == "valid"`.
  WHY: For an invalid done-check, `acceptance.items` is always empty, so downstream callers such as the donecheck helper get zero checks even when the plan specified some. Rated NIT.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:6228-6245 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Create Pull Request step calls `ensure_label_exists` (`gh label create`) before adding `--label` to `gh pr create`. The `::warning::` fallback fires only when the helper is unavailable, not when the create itself fails.
  WHY: If the label already exists and `ensure_label_exists` returns non-zero, `--label` is silently omitted. The existing-PR branch (line ~6326) runs only when `ACCEPTANCE_UNMET_LABEL` is non-empty, so the label is never added. The step also adds a write on a hot path. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Plan P3 item 5 (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:404): "`scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh` main (579+) and its `--phase resolver` use: the same loop over `rpg_*`." The issue also says "Do not pull in work from other phases and do not shrink P3's scope".
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh::review_prepush_test_gate_cmd_gate and the resolver caller scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh::_resolver_prepush_test_gate
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The persist loop was added only to `review_prepush_test_gate_main`. `review_prepush_test_gate_cmd_gate` (lines 1133-1189) gained only the `--tests-file` / `--expect-baseline-fail-file` pass-through, still runs the gate once, and its header says "no caller yet" (scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:26-27). The resolver caller scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh runs run1, does one sandbox repair, then runs run2 (lines 1070-1073 and 1157-1160), with no `PERSIST_REPAIR_LOOP_ENABLED` loop and no done-check input. The agents.d fragment says "The resolver keeps its single repair". The editor deferred the work only because of the files_touched grant, which the issue does not authorise. Severity disagreement: four reviewers rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rated it NIT with confidence 3 and treats it as a grant-scoped deferral, because review_conflict_resolve.sh is outside files_touched.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:990-992 (run_gate 1037, 1050; _run_one 651-653) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The red-on-base acceptance rerun in `_baseline_target_statuses` uses the plain gate `deadline` after the last run removed the BASELINE_MIN_SECS floor. The comment saying classify_baseline "already takes the one BASELINE_MIN_SECS floor" does not apply to this rerun.
  WHY: Once the budget is used up, red-on-base targets that passed on head time out unstarted and are recorded as `base: "unverified"` / "not run". The done-check never reaches `met`, and `ai:acceptance-unmet` is never removed. Fix: compute `baseline_deadline = max(deadline, time.monotonic() + BASELINE_MIN_SECS)` once and pass it to both calls (about 3 lines).
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:review_prepush_test_gate_acceptance_label_main unmet branch (scripts/label_helpers.sh 186-202) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: In a fresh process, `ensure_label_exists` always sends `gh label create` before the POST, so each newly-unmet round makes 2 writes against the documented "at most 1 label write per review round".
  WHY: The documented §14 budget is exceeded. test_acceptance_label_writes_at_most_once misses it because `_with_fake_gh` never stages label_helpers.sh. Fix: POST first and call ensure_label_exists only on failure.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Plan P3 item 5 (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md line 404), `--phase resolver` uses the same loop over `rpg_*`. Expected change site: scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh review_prepush_test_gate_cmd_gate and scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh. Evidence of absence: cmd_gate gains only pass-through flags and its header says "no caller yet"; there is no persist loop or done-check prep in the resolver path; the agents.d fragment says "The resolver keeps its single repair"; the deferral rests only on files_touched. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- Verification notes (not findings): rejected the plan_units(repo) vs baseline concern; rejected "ensure_label_exists may be undefined" because the call is guarded by `type`; rejected the test_agents_fragment_contract / test_ai_labels failures as sandbox artifacts; did not re-flag excluding "unmet (passes on base)" from extra_unmet.
- Hardening suggestions: shared baseline_deadline at run_gate 1037/1050 (3 lines); POST-first label write (4 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
